The dust is visible but reads as the main arc itself rather than fine debris emanating from an already-established ring edge.

The dark violet-black background and blue/violet luminous particles create an appropriate mystical palette. Both frames show a clearly circular, rotating/sweeping particle formation, so animation is evident. However, the portal still reads primarily as a sparse dotted circle rather than a strong, continuous glowing annulus. The edge dust is not visually distinct from the ring itself: most particles sit on the same circular path, with too little dense core-versus-loose-debris separation.

There is essentially no broad glow halo, and the ring core is not dense or bright enough to visually separate from the loose dust particles.
